/overnight_review

I just added a bunch of comments to the artifacts. I'm going to be honest, I am completely and utterly disappointed and dissatisfied with this round. Look at my comments and see what I'm talking about. Either what I asked was not followed, or it was followed in the most rigid, unintuitive, incohesive way possible. It seems like no thought was put into things. It seems like my comments about concepts, mindsets, and philosophies when designing were just not followed, or followed completely unideally. Seems like there was no common sense, no intentionality, and no purpose behind a lot of the things here. I'm just honestly really disappointed, and I need it fixed ASAP with no excuses and actually done ideally, like I've been saying for the past 7 days. We're getting this done, and I'm done with these crappy, unideal, suboptimal, trashy looks. If you have any questions, ask me, and don't make stupid decisions. The overnight review, if applicable for the question, should be asked to me with your recommendation for as many that are needed. Once again, orchestrate this lean and get this done. I feel like this shouldn't be difficult. The things I'm asking for are not crazy. In fact, they're common sense.</command-args>
